text.description_html:
Laurey Melrose Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Bar Pull

The Melrose Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Bar Pull is a great addition to any modern kitchen. The sleek, simple lines of these slim cabinet pull make it modern and the oil rubbed bronze color finishes the look. The Oil Rubbed Bronze Melrose Cabinet Pull comes packaged with mounting hardware. Choose from a few different lengths.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Melrose Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available in 5 Sizes:

    LAU-87066:
    • C/C Length: 3"
    • Overall Length: 5"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-87166:
    • C/C Length: 3-3/4"
    • Total Length: 5-3/4"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-87266:
    • C/C Length: 4"
    • Total Length: 6"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-87366:
    • C/C Length: 5"
    • Total Length: 7"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-87466:
    • C/C Length: 7-1/2"
    • Total Length: 9-1/2"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"
